config.blockupdateviewer.title: Block Update Viewer Config
config.blockupdateviewer.option.lingerTi:
Keep renders for x extra gameticks.

E.G. 1 linger tick makes updates appear for 2GT, or 1 RT
config.blockupdateviewer.option.renderMo: Changes rendering of block updates, not selection rendering.
config.blockupdateviewer.option.occlusio:
Lazy implementation, checking only the nearest 3 corners of a chunk and the center point.

Will cause flickering !!
Define the radius [ in chunks ] around the player in which the over-aggressive occlusion culling won't take place.
config.blockupdateviewer.option.comparat: For comparator updates; A subtype of NC only sent to comparators.
config.blockupdateviewer.option.maxUniqu:
Caps the amount of entries sent by the tracker to the renderer every tick.

Lower values will help performance, but some updates may be skipped. This only affects the visuals.
config.blockupdateviewer.option.logtofil:
Log updates per-world to file. Viewable in tick sheet
[ CLIENT-SIDE ONLY ]
config.blockupdateviewer.option.logDupli:
If disabled, skips logging identical entries on the same tick.

Only enable if you need to study quantum mechanics.
Sub-tick update order is preserved in both cases
config.blockupdateviewer.option.logQueue:
If queue fills past this value, additional updates will be dropped.

Does not affect rendering.
config.blockupdateviewer.option.persiste:
If disabled, deletes ~/logs/{MOD_ID}/* when the game exits, erasing all logged entries.

Large log files will take longer to load in the tick sheet.
config.blockupdateviewer.option.verbosel:
Log internal events as they occur.

Don't enable unless something's wrong: This will lag your game !
config.blockupdateviewer.option.networkl:
Log each packet received by client to the terminal.

Don't enable unless something's wrong: This will lag your game !
